blocks.note: What the diagram shows: orchestration as a control loop with budgets — agents act inside policy envelopes and hand off before the envelope ends.

blocks.x: What holds Autonomous Workflow Orchestration together is discipline at the boundaries — typed contracts between stages, versioned releases, and a replay trail for every decision. The diagram above shows how the pieces compose; the gate reviews are what keep them honest.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Autonomous Workflow Orchestration capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
